sections.title: Growth and range
sections.text: Tacinga funalis is a Brazilian Caatinga cactus with long, scandent growth and cylindrical stems; published descriptions report shoots reaching up to about 12 m. It differs from the flat-padded T. inamoena and T. saxatilis.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The taxonomic description records pale-green inner flower segments and a bottle-shaped fruit that can mature from green to reddish or purple. The local plate instead shows broad flat pads, a bright red-orange flower and an oval red fruit, so it does not match this species and is not displayed.

sections.title: Food and safety
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish edible parts or a species-specific toxicity profile.
